cutscenes.name: IntroStandardTwoTeams_01

cutscenes.name: IntroFinalsTournament_02
cutscenes.note: PARKED (see to-do.md, anzac-cutscene): last two camera shots go black. Anzac walk-out: both teams walk out of the tunnel side by side and form two lines near halfway (R25 finals-tournament walk, 21 s). Stripped to a solemn version: no trophy/ball props, fireworks, flames or loudspeaker music - just the crowd. Shifted 25 m (15 m froze the intro layout: players started 57 m back, past RL26's furthest run-out start of 48.8 m) towards the field by clipOffsets. TESTING: replaces the regular intro every casual match (introSequences r25_anzac). Cameras 18/20 follow players 21/5 (moveRelativeToActorLabel); those optional slots were left empty (black shots), so actorFields gives them the captains, who are always present
